evidence.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attempt_answers ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, attempt_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_attempts (id), pinned_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES pinned_items (id), payload TEXT, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, expired BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, UNIQUE (attempt_id, pinned_item_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attempt_heartbeats ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, attempt_id BIGINT UNIQUE REFERENCES exam_attempts (id), last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attempt_reports ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, attempt_public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, student_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, published BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attempt_security_events ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, attempt_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_attempts (id), attempt_public_id UUID NOT NULL, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, student_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, client_event_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, violation_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, detail TEXT, client_occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, detected_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_attempt_security_events_attempt_client UNIQUE (attempt_id, client_event_id), CONSTRAINT ck_attempt_security_events_violation_type CHECK (violation_type IN ( 'LOCKDOWN_FULLSCREEN_EXIT', 'LOCKDOWN_CLIPBOARD_PASTE', 'LOCKDOWN_SHORTCUT_BLOCKED', 'LOCKDOWN_FORBIDDEN_APP_DETECTED' )), CONSTRAINT ck_attempt_security_events_severity CHECK (severity IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL')) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, actor_user_id UUID NOT NULL, aggregate_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, aggregate_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, summary VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blueprint_items ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, blueprint_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_blueprints (id), question_public_id UUID NOT NULL, section VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, order_index INTEGER NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_memberships ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, student_class_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_classes (id), student_public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS enrollments ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id), student_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, UNIQUE (session_id, student_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_attempts ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, student_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, submitted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, exam_end_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, device_check_passed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, current_order_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, play_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_play_request_id VARCHAR(255), last_play_allowed BOOLEAN, active_section VARCHAR(255), section_started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, version BIGINT, UNIQUE (session_public_id, student_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_audience_members ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, student_public_id UUID NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(32), source_summary VARCHAR(1000), prior_session_public_id UUID, prior_session_name VARCHAR(255), prior_status VARCHAR(16), published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, UNIQUE (session_id, student_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_audience_sources ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, source_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, source_public_id UUID NOT NULL, created_by UUID, UNIQUE (session_id, source_type, source_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_blueprints ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_forms ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id), snapshot_public_id UUID NOT NULL, form_index INTEGER NOT NULL, form_seed BIGINT NOT NULL, algorithm_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, pool_policy_fingerprint VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, UNIQUE (session_id, form_index) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_generation_jobs ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, algorithm_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, base_seed BIGINT NOT NULL, forms_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, forms_completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, UNIQUE (session_id, idempotency_key) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_session_incident_history ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_session_incidents (id), incident_public_id UUID NOT NULL, actor_public_id UUID NOT NULL, actor_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, actor_role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, from_status VARCHAR(32), to_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, notes TEXT )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_session_incidents ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, student_public_id UUID, attempt_public_id UUID, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NEW', reporter_role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, reporter_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, reporter_public_id UUID NOT NULL, current_owner_role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, current_owner_name VARCHAR(255), resolution_summary TEXT )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_session_selected_skills ( session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, skill VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_exam_session_selected_skills_session_skill UNIQUE (session_id, skill), CONSTRAINT chk_exam_session_selected_skill CHECK (skill IN ('SPEAKING', 'WRITING', 'READING', 'LISTENING')) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_session_selected_skills ( session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, skill VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_exam_session_selected_skills_session_skill UNIQUE (session_id, skill), CONSTRAINT chk_exam_session_selected_skill CHECK (skill IN ('SPEAKING', 'WRITING', 'READING', 'LISTENING')) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_sessions ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, snapshot_public_id UUID NOT NULL, opens_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, closes_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, capacity INTEGER, replay_policy_type VARCHAR(16), replay_policy_limit INTEGER, device_check_required BOOLEAN, proctor_required BOOLEAN, answer_integrity_level VARCHAR(16), lockdown_mode VARCHAR(16) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_snapshots ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, source_blueprint_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS examiner_answer_drafts ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, work_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES examiner_grading_work (id), answer_public_id UUID NOT NULL, score INTEGER, comment VARCHAR(2000), decision_kind VARCHAR(32), expected_review_version VARCHAR(128), reviewed_ai_version VARCHAR(128), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, saved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_examiner_draft_work_answer UNIQUE (work_id, answer_public_id), CONSTRAINT ck_examiner_draft_score CHECK (score IS NULL OR (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100)) )

CREATE TABLE examiner_answer_scores ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, answer_public_id UUID NOT NULL, attempt_public_id UUID NOT NULL, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, examiner_public_id UUID NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status = 'SUBMITTED'), submitted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, lock_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT uq_examiner_answer_score_answer UNIQUE (answer_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE examiner_assignment_batches ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, created_by_public_id UUID NOT NULL, mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('MANUAL', 'RANDOM')), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PREVIEWED', 'COMMITTED', 'EXPIRED')), scope_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, assignment_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, random_seed UUID, preview_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, committed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, lock_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 )

CREATE TABLE examiner_attempt_assignments ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, batch_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, attempt_public_id UUID NOT NULL, examiner_public_id UUID NOT NULL, assigned_by_public_id UUID NOT NULL, assigned_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_examiner_assignment_session_attempt UNIQUE (session_public_id, attempt_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS examiner_grading_commands ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, examiner_public_id UUID NOT NULL, assignment_public_id UUID NOT NULL, request_public_id UUID NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, fingerprint VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_examiner_cmd_receipt UNIQUE (tenant_id, examiner_public_id, assignment_public_id, request_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS examiner_grading_events ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, work_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES examiner_grading_work (id), answer_public_id UUID, operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, work_version BIGINT NOT NULL, draft_version BIGINT, metadata JSONB, occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS examiner_grading_issues ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, work_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES examiner_grading_work (id), answer_public_id UUID, type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', reported_by UUID NOT NULL, reported_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, resolved_by UUID, resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, resolution VARCHAR(2000) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS examiner_grading_work ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, attempt_public_id UUID NOT NULL, assignment_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES examiner_attempt_assignments (public_id), examiner_public_id UUID NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, finalized_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT uq_examiner_grading_work_assignment UNIQUE (tenant_id, assignment_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS form_assignments ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_sessions (id), form_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_forms (id), student_public_id UUID NOT NULL, UNIQUE (session_id, student_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lecturer_assignments ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, student_class_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_classes (id), assignee_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_lecturer_assignment_class_assignee UNIQUE (student_class_id, assignee_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS license_codes ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, plan_id UUID NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, issued_by UUID NOT NULL, issued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, code_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, redeemed_by_tenant_id UUID, redeemed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, subscription_id UUID UNIQUE, revoke_reason VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT chk_license_codes_status CHECK (status IN ('ISSUED', 'REDEEMED', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED')), CONSTRAINT chk_license_codes_redeem_fields CHECK ( (status = 'ISSUED' AND redeemed_by_tenant_id IS NULL AND redeemed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('REDEEMED', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED')) ) )

CREATE TABLE license_issue_intents ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, actor_public_id UUID NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key UUID NOT NULL, payload_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, license_code_public_id UUID NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_license_issue_intents_actor_operation_key UNIQUE (actor_public_id, operation, idempotency_key), CONSTRAINT fk_license_issue_intents_license_code FOREIGN KEY (license_code_public_id) REFERENCES license_codes(public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_hashes ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE, hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_objects ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, owner_public_id UUID NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, storage_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, audio_prompt BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, duration_seconds INTEGER )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_announcements ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, author_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(public_id), title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, body VARCHAR(5000) NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('SYSTEM_NOTICE','MAINTENANCE')), importance VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (importance IN ('INFO','IMPORTANT')), affected_from TIMESTAMPTZ, affected_until TIMESTAMPTZ, published_content_public_id UUID UNIQUE REFERENCES notification_inbox_contents(public_id), published_at TIMESTAMPTZ, correction_of_public_id UUID REFERENCES notification_inbox_announcements(public_id), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK (affected_until IS NULL OR (affected_from IS NOT NULL AND affected_until > affected_from)), CHECK ((published_at IS NULL) = (published_content_public_id IS NULL)) )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_contents ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, event_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = 1), payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (length(payload_hash) = 64), notification_type VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL CHECK (notification_type IN ('APPLICATION_SUBMITTED','PLATFORM_ANNOUNCEMENT','SESSION_CLOSING_SOON','SESSION_GRADING_COMPLETED','COMMERCIAL_OUTCOME_CONFIRMED','ORDER_EXPIRED','SUBSCRIPTION_REVOKED')), category VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('SYSTEM_NOTICE','MAINTENANCE','SESSION','APPLICATION','BILLING')), importance VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (importance IN ('INFO','IMPORTANT')), title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), body VARCHAR(5000) NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body)) > 0), target_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('APPLICATION','ANNOUNCEMENT','SESSION','ORDER','SUBSCRIPTION','QUOTA')), target_public_id UUID NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_deliveries ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, content_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_inbox_contents(public_id), recipient_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(public_id), tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(public_id), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING','DELIVERED','FAILED','SUPPRESSED')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, claim_token UUID, lease_until TIMESTAMPTZ, last_failure_code VARCHAR(64), completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, UNIQUE (content_public_id, recipient_user_public_id), CHECK ((status = 'PROCESSING') = (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)) )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_items ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, delivery_public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES notification_inbox_deliveries(public_id), content_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_inbox_contents(public_id), recipient_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_inbox_streams(recipient_user_public_id), tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(public_id), sequence_no BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0), delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, read_at TIMESTAMPTZ, UNIQUE (content_public_id, recipient_user_public_id), UNIQUE (recipient_user_public_id, sequence_no) )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_snapshots ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), recipient_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(public_id), tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(public_id), upper_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (upper_sequence >= 0), read_revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (read_revision >= 0), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at > created_at) )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_snapshots ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), recipient_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(public_id), tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(public_id), upper_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (upper_sequence >= 0), read_revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (read_revision >= 0), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at > created_at) )

CREATE TABLE notification_inbox_streams ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, recipient_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(public_id), tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(public_id), last_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_sequence >= 0), read_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (read_revision >= 0) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_logs ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, recipient_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL, recipient_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, notification_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, subject VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, plan_id UUID NOT NULL, order_code BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE, amount NUMERIC(19, 2) NOT NULL, currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, payment_link_url VARCHAR(512), paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT chk_orders_amount CHECK (amount > 0), CONSTRAINT chk_orders_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organizations ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants (id), name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, address VARCHAR(255), facility_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_transactions ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, order_code BIGINT, raw_payload TEXT NOT NULL, signature_valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL, received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, processed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pinned_exam_snapshots ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, attempt_id BIGINT UNIQUE REFERENCES exam_attempts (id), source_snapshot_public_id UUID NOT NULL, source_session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, replay_policy_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, replay_policy_limit INTEGER, device_check_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, proctor_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, answer_integrity_level VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, lockdown_mode VARCHAR(20) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, plan_id UUID NOT NULL, license_key VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, starts_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, max_students_per_session INTEGER NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, activation_source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT chk_subscriptions_dates CHECK (expires_at > starts_at), CONSTRAINT chk_subscriptions_cap CHECK (max_students_per_session > 0), CONSTRAINT chk_subscriptions_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED')), CONSTRAINT chk_subscriptions_source CHECK (activation_source IN ('PAYMENT', 'LICENSE_CODE')) )

CREATE TABLE support_ticket ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, submitter_user_public_id UUID NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN', entity_type VARCHAR(32), entity_id VARCHAR(36), CONSTRAINT chk_support_ticket_entity_pair CHECK ((entity_type IS NULL) = (entity_id IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT chk_support_ticket_status CHECK (status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED')), CONSTRAINT chk_support_ticket_entity_id_uuid CHECK (entity_id IS NULL OR entity_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') )

CREATE TABLE support_ticket_note ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ticket_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES support_ticket (id), ticket_public_id UUID NOT NULL, admin_public_id UUID NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_runtime_contracts ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, screen_key VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL, profile_key VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL, behavior_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, renderer_key VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, answer_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, scoring_profile_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, scoring_profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL, scoring_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, required_client_capabilities TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', min_supported_app_version VARCHAR(32), authoring_contract_key VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, authoring_contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL, requires_audio_prompt BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, requires_image_prompt BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, requires_prompt_text BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, requires_options BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, requires_correct_answer BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, requires_word_count BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, requires_single_correct_option BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, uses_option_order_as_correct_position BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', CONSTRAINT ux_task_runtime_contract_screen_version UNIQUE (screen_key, contract_version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_runtime_profiles ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, task_type_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, profile_key VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL, behavior_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, renderer_key VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, answer_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, scoring_profile_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, scoring_profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL, required_client_capabilities VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ux_task_runtime_profiles_task_version UNIQUE (task_type_code, profile_version) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_type_publication_usage ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, task_type_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, template_public_id UUID NOT NULL, template_version_public_id UUID NOT NULL, published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, actor_public_id UUID, audit_reference VARCHAR(128), CONSTRAINT ux_task_type_publication_usage_template_task UNIQUE (task_type_key, template_version_public_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_applications ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, org_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, org_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, requested_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, contact_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, contact_phone VARCHAR(255), tax_code VARCHAR(255), status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, reviewed_by UUID, reviewed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, reject_reason VARCHAR(500) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenants ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, organization_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, package_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, student_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, logo_url VARCHAR(255), primary_color VARCHAR(255), version BIGINT )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_roles ( user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_roles ( user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, email VARCHAR(255), full_name VARCHAR(255), tenant_id UUID, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, student_code VARCHAR(255), class_name VARCHAR(255), phone VARCHAR(255), date_of_birth DATE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS violation_events ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, public_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, proctor_session_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES proctor_sessions (id), session_public_id UUID NOT NULL, attempt_public_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, violation_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, detail TEXT, sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL, prev_hash VARCHAR(64), hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, detected_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL )
